# Good Character Interactions Examples
# Demonstrates proper character interaction structure

# Example 1: Complete character interaction
request_favor = {
	category = interaction_category_diplomacy

	desc = request_favor_desc
	greeting = positive
	notification_text = REQUEST_FAVOR_NOTIFICATION

	is_shown = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_adult = yes
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			is_adult = yes
		}
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		scope:actor = {
			NOT = { has_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
	}

	on_accept = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_hook = {
				target = scope:recipient
				type = favor_hook
			}
		}

		scope:recipient = {
			add_opinion = {
				target = scope:actor
				modifier = granted_favor_opinion
			}
		}
	}

	on_decline = {
		scope:recipient = {
			add_opinion = {
				target = scope:actor
				modifier = declined_favor_opinion
			}
		}
	}

	ai_targets = {
		ai_recipients = liege
	}

	ai_frequency = 60

	ai_potential = {
		is_at_war = no
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 50

		modifier = {
			add = 25
			scope:actor = {
				has_trait = ambitious
			}
		}
	}

	ai_accept = {
		base = 25

		modifier = {
			add = 50
			scope:recipient = {
				opinion = {
					target = scope:actor
					value >= 50
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Example 2: Simple interaction
send_gift = {
	category = interaction_category_diplomacy

	desc = send_gift_desc

	is_shown = {
		scope:actor = {
			gold >= 50
		}
	}

	on_accept = {
		scope:actor = {
			remove_short_term_gold = 50
		}

		scope:recipient = {
			add_gold = 50
			add_opinion = {
				target = scope:actor
				modifier = gift_opinion
			}
		}
	}

	ai_frequency = 120

	ai_accept = {
		base = 100
	}
}

# Example 3: Interaction with cooldown
demand_conversion = {
	category = interaction_category_hostile

	desc = demand_conversion_desc

	is_shown = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_ruler = yes
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			NOT = { faith = scope:actor.faith }
		}
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		scope:actor = {
			NOT = {
				has_character_modifier = recently_demanded_conversion
			}
		}
	}

	on_accept = {
		scope:recipient = {
			set_character_faith = scope:actor.faith
		}

		scope:actor = {
			add_character_modifier = {
				modifier = recently_demanded_conversion
				years = 5
			}
		}
	}

	ai_frequency = 240

	ai_accept = {
		base = 10

		modifier = {
			add = 50
			scope:recipient = {
				is_imprisoned_by = scope:actor
			}
		}
	}
}
